# jamfplatform_pro_building (Data Source)

Look up a Jamf Pro building by ID.

**Required Jamf permissions**

Grant the API integration the following permissions in Jamf Account — see [Getting started with the Platform API](https://developer.jamf.com/platform-api/reference/getting-started-with-platform-api). `Category` and `Permission` name the section and row of the permission picker; `Actions` are the boxes to tick within that row.

| Category | Permission | Actions | API capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Organizational context | Buildings | Read | `buildings` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jamfplatform_pro_building" "example_by_id" {
  id = "12"
}

output "building_example_by_id" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_building.example_by_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Building ID to look up.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `city` (String) City the building is located in.
- `country` (String) Country the building is located in.
- `name` (String) Building display name.
- `state_province` (String) State, province, or administrative region.
- `street_address_1` (String) Primary street address line.
- `street_address_2` (String) Secondary street address line.
- `zip_postal_code` (String) Zip or postal code.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
